steps.title: What Is a Percent?
steps.content: A percent tells you how many parts out of 100. 50% means 50 out of 100 — exactly half. Think of it as a friendly fraction with 100 on the bottom.

steps.title: See 25%
steps.content: Imagine a bar split into 4 equal parts. Each part is 25%. Shade one part — that's 25 out of 100.

steps.title: Find 20% of $50
steps.content:
Step 1: Convert 20% to a decimal → 0.20
Step 2: Multiply → 0.20 × 50 = 10
Answer: $10
